stem.text: Which statement correctly explains the result when the two molecules shown in the diagram react together?

stem.alt: Two ring-shaped sugar molecules joined through an oxygen atom, with H2O written below an arrow pointing from the join.

A.text: A hydrolysis reaction is forming the disaccharide maltose.

B.text: A reducing sugar is split into two monosaccharides by hydrolysis.

C.text: Condensation of two α-glucose molecules is taking place.

D.text: A condensation reaction is forming two reducing sugars.
